packs.title: Unishop electronics store
packs.description: An electronics store with 20 products across phones, audio, watches, laptops, power and accessories: specs on every product, sale prices, variable products, brands, reviews, buying guides and store pages.

packs.title: Bytewell store for Twenty Twenty-Five
packs.description: A small electronics store in Twenty Twenty-Five's Noon style: a homepage with a trust strip, category tiles, a product spotlight, customer reviews, sale and featured products, 8 products, 3 categories, 2 brands, store pages and a journal.

packs.title: eBasket grocery store
packs.description: A neighbourhood grocer with 37 products in 8 aisles: pack sizes and nutrition panels on every food, diet tags, offers with end dates, a variable coffee, reviews, recipes, store pages and a demo checkout with free delivery over £40.

packs.title: Luma skincare formulary
packs.description: A skincare and beauty shop with 39 products in 8 categories: key actives with their strength, pH, texture, skin type, concern, routine step, size and full ingredients on every formula, two variable products sold by shade and one by size, offers with end dates, reviews, a journal, store pages and a demo checkout with free delivery over £35.

packs.title: Vitrena showroom
packs.description: An authorised dealer for considered electronics: 23 products from nine makers across hi-fi, headphones, watches, cameras, and desk and mobile, each with key figures, warranty and box contents; ex-display and certified pre-owned pieces, a variable phone, reviews, store pages, a journal and a demo checkout with free insured delivery over $500.

packs.title: Gadgetix gadget store
packs.description: A gadget store with 25 products in 6 gadget categories: what each works with (a filterable attribute), battery life, charging speed, capacity, water ratings, ports and real dimensions for the actual size drawing; drops with end dates, low and sold-out stock, a variable cable, reviews, buying guides, store pages and a demo checkout with free delivery over $50.

packs.title: Yantra business site
packs.description: A calm business site: a homepage built from Yantra's patterns with features, figures, testimonials, plans, questions and the latest posts; About, Pricing and Contact pages; six posts in four categories with photos; a main and a footer menu, four footer widgets, an announcement bar, a sticky header, a logo and the Customizer settings to match. Needs no plugin besides Storefill.

packs.title: Yantra business site
packs.description: A calm business site: a homepage built from its own patterns with features, figures, testimonials, plans, questions and the latest posts; About, Pricing and Contact pages; six posts in four categories with photos; a main and a footer menu, four footer widgets, an announcement bar, a sticky header, a logo and the Customizer settings to match. Its 15 patterns join the site's own patterns. For Yantra Pro.

packs.title: Daybook lifestyle blog
packs.description: A lifestyle blog in four sections, Cook, Grow, Make and Rest: 23 posts with photos and tags, a three-part bread series, a quote post, a featured slider of sticky posts, Masonry with infinite scroll, a table of contents, floating share buttons, view counts, dark mode with a header switch, a phone bar, About, Contact and Privacy pages, menus, footer widgets and a logo. For Yantra Pro.

packs.title: Kerbside café and bakery
packs.description: A neighbourhood café, roastery and bakery that takes orders ahead: a homepage built from its own patterns, with a till-receipt hero, fresh bakes with the stock left, the menu in tiles and beans by post as receipts; Menu, Order ahead, Our story and Visit pages; 19 products (drinks with a choice of milk, bakes with their own badges and a back-in-stock date, beans by grind); opening hours with last orders and an open bar; six journal posts; menus, footer widgets, a logo and dark mode. For Yantra Pro.

packs.title: Skylark digital marketing studio
packs.description: A digital marketing studio for local businesses: a homepage with a results board, services, a local SEO page with map results, six case studies, pricing with a monthly and yearly switch, About, a free audit page and an ad landing page on the Blank canvas template whose headline matches the ad it came from; six articles with a table of contents, a reading bar and share buttons; a Services mega menu, an exit popup and an offer inside posts (Yantra Pro content blocks); an offer bar, a sticky header with Call and Free audit buttons, dark mode, the phone bar, menus, footer widgets and a logo. For Yantra Pro.

packs.title: Copperline home services
packs.description: A family firm of plumbers, heating engineers and electricians that takes bookings in two-hour arrival windows: a homepage with the day's free windows, problems as photo cards, fixed-price jobs, how a visit works, the areas it covers on a map, reviews and the two-year guarantee; a services hub and five trade pages with what each trade fixes, typical prices and questions people ask; Book online (the shop) with 13 jobs to book by day and window, each window with its own stock, and four add-ons; Prices, an Areas page with a ZIP code checker, About and six advice posts. Yantra Pro's booking wording ("Only 4 windows left this week", "Booked up · next windows on Monday", "Book within 2h 40m for today"), windows left on the swatches, office hours, own badges, a Services mega menu, the cart drawer as Your booking, a calendar in the header, dark mode and the phone bar with a raised Call button. For Yantra Pro.

packs.title: Tag & Twine department store
packs.description: A store of many departments, in the layout of the big ones: an "All departments" menu with a flyout for each, a search that picks the department, a sale hero with a swing tag, department tiles, today's deals with a countdown to midnight, new arrivals in tabs, best sellers, on sale and top rated lists, a summer banner and the journal; 55 products in clothing, shoes, bags, accessories, tech, home and beauty, most of them in several colours and sizes with what's left of each, colour dots on the cards, sale and New badges, a welcome popup with a code to copy, the cart drawer with free delivery over $50 and products to add, quick view, filters, a wishlist, a size guide, sale, gift and summer pages, help and returns, and three journal posts. For Yantra Pro.
